subject.title: Feishu: bot does not respond when @-mentioned in a reply message

question: Should maintainers repair or adopt the open external Feishu candidate, or start a fresh same-repository fix for this reply @mention bug?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible, but the same-repository PR is closed and the only open candidate is external, conflicting, and previously associated with safety concerns around orphan placeholders and root routing.

options.title: Repair or replace the candidate
options.body: Use the open candidate as source context, but land a current-main fix with bot-specific mention evidence and routing tests.

options.title: Wait on the fork author
options.body: Keep this issue open while asking the fork author to rebase and address the mention-gating and routing concerns.

options.title: Defer Feishu reply work
options.body: Leave this as an open known Feishu bug until channel ownership bandwidth is available.

recommendation.title: Repair or replace the candidate
recommendation.body: Use the open candidate as source context, but land a current-main fix with bot-specific mention evidence and routing tests.
